backend/main.mo: Minimal Motoko actor with no functions.
feature_evidence.json: Feature report listing implemented site features, related files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Reference file summarizing major frontend components and configuration files.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base and utility setup defining OKLCH color variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point setting SEO meta description, title, and mounting root div.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app component composing navigation, all page sections, and footer.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer with dynamic year and Caffeine.ai attribution link.
frontend/src/components/sections/AboutSe: About section with company overview and highlight cards describing strengths.
frontend/src/components/sections/Contact: Contact section providing business info and an inquiry form with basic state handling.
frontend/src/components/sections/HeroSec: Landing hero section with background image, scroll-to buttons, and three stat cards.
frontend/src/components/sections/Project: Displays a grid of project cards with images, titles, and descriptions.
frontend/src/components/sections/Service: Renders a services grid using cards with icons, titles, and descriptions.
frontend/src/components/TopNav.tsx: Responsive sticky top navigation with logo, smooth-scroll links, and mobile menu.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor, refreshing queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth context with login, logout, state handling, and stored identity loading.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and a custom color palette using CSS variables for light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point setting up React Query, Internet Identity provider, and global styles.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending colors, fonts, animations, and enabling plugins like typography and container queries.
project_state.json: Defines the website project state, required images, existing implemented features, and initial new feature request data for a construction business site.
